# Laya Meeting Recap

Reads a Teams meeting you attended, with nothing to upload, and gives you the decisions, a clear action list (what, who, by when), open questions and a ready-to-send follow-up email. For people with the paid Microsoft Copilot licence.

**Who can use it:** people with the paid Microsoft Copilot licence.

## What to upload

Nothing. Tell it which meeting. It needs the meeting to have been transcribed.

## What you get

A summary, decisions, an action table, open questions and a follow-up email ready for you to check and send.

## Example

After the weekly team meeting, ask for the actions. You get five actions with owners and dates, and it asks about the two that had no owner.

## Try saying

- *What did we decide in my last meeting, and who's doing what?*
- *Write the follow-up email for [meeting name].*
- *I need proper minutes for [meeting name] on [date].*

## Tips

- No transcript means it can't tell what was said. Use the free Laya Meeting Actions with your notes instead.
- Transcripts get names and numbers wrong, so check those before you send.
